SSL::clientrandom
       SSL::clientrandom

SYNOPSIS
       SSL::clientrandom

DESCRIPTION
       Return the ClientRandom value from the Client hello.

RETURN VALUE
       The ClientRandom value.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE {
	    log local0.info "negotiated protocol: [SSL::clientrandom]"
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0 --First introduced the command.
